notes:
Zaiqa Billing, Zaiqa Waiter and Zaiqa Kitchen apps, version 2.15.0.

Remote owners - sign in to the main POS from any other phone or PC
- New: Cloud > Remote owners. Add each owner / partner with their own username and password, then open the link on their phone or computer.
- They see the main POS live - the same tables, orders, reports and settings - and everything they do (orders, payments, printing) happens on the main POS exactly as if done on it. Their name shows in the audit log.
- Disable, change the password, sign out or remove an owner at any time. Wrong passwords are blocked after 5 tries.
- Needs the main POS switched on with internet. Deploy the updated Cloudflare worker once (run the "Deploy Cloudflare worker" action or npx wrangler deploy).
